Varsha, an ambitious young woman, strives to overcome personal struggles and societal stigma while Shivananda, a fearless journalist, fights against corruption and deep family secrets.
Rejected by most of her family and community since infancy due to a birth defect, Kanmani aspires to become a fashion designer and support her father.
Families compete against one another in an attempt to claim the title by successfully navigating a series of entertaining quizzes and challenging tasks.
